records.text: The quantum properties of the tmQM data set were obtained from single-point calculations at the DFT level on the GFN2-xTB optimized geometries.
All properties were computed for the closed-shell singlet state.
The calculations were performed in gas phase with the hybrid meta-GGA TPSSh functional and the double-ζ polarized def2-SVP basis set, including effective core potentials for Z > [number withheld].

This level of theory was used to compute the following properties: electronic and dispersion energies, HOMO and LUMO energies, HOMO/LUMO gap, dipole moment, and metal center charge, which was derived from natural population analysis.
In addition to the GFN2-xTB geometries, the tmQM data set provides these DFT properties for all TM complexes.
Polarizabilities are also provided at the GFN2-xTB level based on the self-consistent D[number withheld] model using a Gaussian-weighting scheme.
